packageRules.description: Updates merge with nobody looking at them, so a release waits three days for a compromised or pulled version to come to light. Renovate opens no branch until then, and vulnerability fixes skip the wait.
The pre-commit hook needs a pinned checksum for each tool jar, and CI doesn't run the hook, so a person runs ./gradlew downloadToolJars on these updates before merging.
A major update can change behavior that our checks don't cover, so a person merges it. Renovate still opens it, and the Renovate approval still runs.
The end-to-end test package pins the versions its doctor checks, the same ones as in clerk-ios and clerk/javascript. Vulnerability fixes still open, through vulnerabilityAlerts below.

androidx.lifecycle 2.11 needs compileSdk 37 and Android Gradle plugin 9.1, and our AARs would pass both floors on to every app. React Native and Expo apps build with Android Gradle plugin 8, so lifecycle stays on 2.10 until they move.
androidx.navigation 2.10 needs compileSdk 37, which lifecycle 2.10 keeps us below (see the rule above).
